description: Source code implementing cache tree data structures and functions for managing and verifying cache trees in a Git repository.

methods.name: cache_tree
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cache_tree structure.

methods.name: cache_tree_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a cache_tree and its subtrees.

methods.name: cache_tree_subtree_pos
methods.description: Finds position of a subtree by path within a cache_tree.

methods.name: find_subtree
methods.description: Finds or creates a subtree within a cache_tree.

methods.name: cache_tree_sub
methods.description: Returns the subtree for a given path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: do_invalidate_path
methods.description: Recursively invalidates cache entries along a given path.

methods.name: cache_tree_invalidate_path
methods.description: Invalidates a cache tree path and marks cache as changed.

methods.name: verify_cache
methods.description: Verifies the consistency of the cache entries.

methods.name: discard_unused_subtrees
methods.description: Removes unused subtrees from a cache_tree.

methods.name: cache_tree_fully_valid
methods.description: Checks if a cache_tree and all subtrees are valid.

methods.name: must_check_existence
methods.description: Determines if object existence must be checked for a cache entry.

methods.name: update_one
methods.description: Updates a cache_tree node based on cache entries, writing tree objects.

methods.name: cache_tree_update
methods.description: Updates the cache_tree for an index, creating or modifying tree objects.

methods.name: write_one
methods.description: Serializes a cache_tree node into a buffer.

methods.name: cache_tree_write
methods.description: Serializes the entire cache_tree starting from root.

methods.name: parse_int
methods.description: Parses an integer from a buffer.

methods.name: read_one
methods.description: Deserializes a cache_tree from a buffer.

methods.name: cache_tree_read
methods.description: Reads a cache_tree from a buffer.

methods.name: cache_tree_find
methods.description: Finds a cache_tree node by path.

methods.name: write_index_as_tree_internal
methods.description: Writes the index as a tree object, updating the cache_tree.

methods.name: write_in_core_index_as_tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the in-memory index.

methods.name: write_index_as_tree
methods.description: Writes the index as a tree object, with locking.

methods.name: prime_cache_tree
methods.description: Constructs cache_tree from a given tree object.

methods.name: find_cache_tree_from_traversal
methods.description: Finds cache_tree node corresponding to traversal info.

methods.name: cache_tree_matches_traversal
methods.description: Checks if cache_tree matches traversal info.

methods.name: verify_one_sparse
methods.description: Verifies sparse directory entries in index.

methods.name: verify_one
methods.description: Verifies cache_tree consistency with index entries.

methods.name: cache_tree_verify
methods.description: Verifies the cache_tree for an index.
